formula: Catalysis Potential Score = w1 x CO2 Affinity + w2 x Active Site Potential + w3 x Pore Accessibility + w4 x Stability + w5 x Electronic Property + w6 x Sustainability + w7 x Evidence Confidence
notes: Catalytic performance depends strongly on reaction conditions.
The score is intended for candidate prioritization, not final performance prediction.
The current rule set uses descriptor cues and evidence confidence only; it is not a trained catalytic model.

descriptorRules.co2Affinity: Normalized from CO2 uptake proxy values in demo records.
descriptorRules.activeSitePotential: Increases with open-metal-site or post-synthetic active-site hypotheses; requires validation.
descriptorRules.poreAccessibility: Uses pore size and surface area to estimate screening-level accessibility.
descriptorRules.stability: Combines water and thermal stability labels.
descriptorRules.electronicProperty: Uses band-gap proximity as a coarse task-fit cue.
descriptorRules.sustainability: Penalizes cost, toxicity, and sustainability-risk placeholders.
descriptorRules.evidenceConfidence: Maps Evidence Level to a confidence modifier; it is not proof of performance.
